title: Verify Parts Technician can see pricing on parts and work orders
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Parts Technician role. (this role has See Financial Data ON).
At least one work order exists that contains labor and part lines with prices entered.
Parts with prices exist.
steps:
1. Click Parts, open the Catalog, and check part prices.
  2. Click Work Orders, open a work order, and check line prices.
expected: Prices are visible with actual amounts in both places.
